findings.finding: Mastery learning requires students to reach a high level of competence before moving forward.
findings.quote: Mastery learning is an instructional strategy and educational philosophy that emphasizes the importance of students achieving a high level of competence

findings.finding: Students who do not achieve mastery receive additional support and repeated assessments until they succeed.
findings.quote: If a student does not initially achieve mastery, they receive additional instruction and support until they do.

findings.finding: Tailoring instruction to the individual time needed for each learner contrasts with traditional fixed-time models.
findings.quote: Mastery-based learning methods emphasize that instruction should be tailored to the individual time needed for each student to master the same content.

principle: Students achieve high competence when they master prerequisite knowledge through repeated practice and personalized time before advancing to new material.
for_the_teacher: Ensure learners reach a high level of competence in a movement before moving on to new material.
Provide repeated opportunities and additional support for learners who do not achieve mastery initially.
